answer_4.quote: Using a sample of 500 CS-sents of our dataset, and Amazon's Mechanical Turk, we recruited 33 native Chinese speakers with high proficiency in English. Each participant was shown 60 pairs of the original code-switched sentences and their translations, such that each pair was verified by 3 participants. Each participant was asked to rate the correctness and fluency of the translations.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant was asked to rate the correctness and fluency of the translations.
